description: Retrieve the complete filter definition of a specific segment (criteria stanzas, operators, values) along with its estimated contact count and metadata. Call this after nevent_list_segments when you need to inspect, clone, or explain a segment's logic. Next step: nevent_segment_preview to count the audience, or nevent_update_segment to modify the definition.

segment_id.description: Identifier of the segment to retrieve. Get valid IDs from nevent_list_segments.

name: nevent_get_segment
